name: Range
description: Represents a cell, a row, a column, a selection of cells containing one or more contiguous blocks of cells, or a 3D range.
remarks: The default member of Range forwards calls without parameters to the Value property and calls with parameters to the Item member. Accordingly, someRange = someOtherRange is equivalent to someRange.Value = someOtherRange.Value, someRange(1) to someRange.Item(1) and someRange(1,1) to someRange.Item(1,1). The following properties and methods for returning a Range object are described in the Example section: - Range and Cells properties of the Worksheet object - Range and Cells properties of the Range object - Rows and Columns properties of the Worksheet object - Rows and Columns properties of the Range object - Offset property of the Range object - Union method of the Application object

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: AddIndent
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that indicates if text is automatically indented when the text alignment in a cell is set to equal distribution (either horizontally or vertically).

properties.name: Address
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the range reference in the language of the macro.

properties.name: AddressLocal
properties.description: Returns the range reference for the specified range in the language of the user. Read-only String.

properties.name: Areas
properties.description: Returns an Areas collection that represents all the ranges in a multiple-area selection. Read-only.

properties.name: Borders
properties.description: Returns a Borders collection that represents the borders of a style or a range of cells (including a range defined as part of a conditional format).

properties.name: Cells
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the cells in the specified range.

properties.name: Characters
properties.description: Returns a Characters object that represents a range of characters within the object text. Use the Characters object to format characters within a text string.

properties.name: Column
properties.description: Returns the number of the first column in the first area in the specified range. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Columns
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the columns in the specified range.

properties.name: ColumnWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the width of all columns in the specified range. Read/write Double.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

properties.name: CurrentArray
properties.description: If the specified cell is part of an array, returns a Range object that represents the entire array. Read-only.

properties.name: CurrentRegion
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the current region. The current region is a range bounded by any combination of blank rows and blank columns. Read-only.

properties.name: Dependents
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range containing all the dependents of a cell. This can be a multiple selection (a union of Range objects) if there's more than one dependent. Read-only Range object.

properties.name: DirectDependents
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range containing all the direct dependents of a cell. This can be a multiple selection (a union of Range objects) if there's more than one dependent. Read-only Range object.

properties.name: DirectPrecedents
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range containing all the direct precedents of a cell. This can be a multiple selection (a union of Range objects) if there's more than one precedent. Read-only Range object.

properties.name: End
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the cell at the end of the region that contains the source range. Equivalent to pressing END+UP ARROW, END+DOWN ARROW, END+LEFT ARROW, or END+RIGHT ARROW. Read-only Range object.

properties.name: EntireColumn
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the entire column (or columns) that contains the specified range. Read-only.

properties.name: EntireRow
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the entire row (or rows) that contains the specified range. Read-only.

properties.name: Font
properties.description: Returns a Font object that represents the font of the specified object.

properties.name: Formula
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the object's implicitly intersecting formula in A1-style notation.

properties.name: FormulaArray
properties.description: Returns or sets the array formula of a range. Returns (or can be set to) a single formula or a Visual Basic array. If the specified range doesn't contain an array formula, this property returns null. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: FormulaHidden
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that indicates if the formula will be hidden when the worksheet is protected.

properties.name: FormulaLocal
properties.description: Returns or sets the formula for the object, using A1-style references in the language of the user. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: FormulaR1C1
properties.description: Returns or sets the formula for the object, using R1C1-style notation in the language of the macro. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: FormulaR1C1Local
properties.description: Returns or sets the formula for the object, using R1C1-style notation in the language of the user. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: HasArray
properties.description: True if the specified cell is part of an array formula. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: HasFormula
properties.description: True if all cells in the range contain formulas; False if none of the cells in the range contains a formula; null otherwise. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns a Double value that represents the height, in points, of the range. Read-only.

properties.name: Hidden
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that indicates if the rows or columns are hidden.

properties.name: HorizontalAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the horizontal alignment for the specified object. Read/write.

properties.name: IndentLevel
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the indent level for the cell or range. Can be an integer from 0 to 15.

properties.name: Interior
properties.description: Returns an Interior object that represents the interior of the specified object.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents a range at an offset to the specified range.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns a Variant value that represents the distance, in points, from the left edge of column A to the left edge of the range.

properties.name: ListHeaderRows
properties.description: Returns the number of header rows for the specified range. Read-only Long.

properties.name: LocationInTable
properties.description: Returns a constant that describes the part of the PivotTable report that contains the upper-left corner of the specified range. Can be one of the following XlLocationInTable constants. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Locked
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that indicates if the object is locked.

properties.name: MergeArea
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the merged range containing the specified cell. If the specified cell isn't in a merged range, this property returns the specified cell. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: MergeCells
properties.description: True if the range contains merged cells. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the name of the object.

properties.name: Next
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the next cell.

properties.name: NumberFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the format code for the object.

properties.name: NumberFormatLocal
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the format code for the object as a string in the language of the user.

properties.name: Offset
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents a range that's offset from the specified range.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the text orientation.

properties.name: OutlineLevel
properties.description: Returns or sets the current outline level of the specified row or column. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: PageBreak
properties.description: Returns or sets the location of a page break. Can be one of the following XlPageBreak constants: xlPageBreakAutomatic, xlPageBreakManual, or xlPageBreakNone. Read/write Long.

properties.name: PivotField
properties.description: Returns a PivotField object that represents the PivotTable field containing the upper-left corner of the specified range.

properties.name: PivotItem
properties.description: Returns a PivotItem object that represents the PivotTable item containing the upper-left corner of the specified range.

properties.name: PivotTable
properties.description: Returns a PivotTable object that represents the PivotTable report containing the upper-left corner of the specified range.

properties.name: Precedents
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents all the precedents of a cell. This can be a multiple selection (a union of Range objects) if there's more than one precedent. Read-only.

properties.name: PrefixCharacter
properties.description: Returns the prefix character for the cell. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: Previous
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the previous cell.

properties.name: QueryTable
properties.description: Returns a QueryTable object that represents the query table that intersects the specified Range object.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents a cell or a range of cells.

properties.name: Resize
properties.description: Resizes the specified range. Returns a Range object that represents the resized range.

properties.name: Row
properties.description: Returns the number of the first row of the first area in the range. Read-only Long.

properties.name: RowHeight
properties.description: Returns or sets the height of the first row in the range specified, measured in points. Read/write Double.

properties.name: Rows
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the rows in the specified range.

properties.name: ShowDetail
properties.description: True if the outline is expanded for the specified range (so that the detail of the column or row is visible). The specified range must be a single summary column or row in an outline. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: ShrinkToFit
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that indicates if text automatically shrinks to fit in the available column width.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value containing a Style object that represents the style of the specified range.

properties.name: Summary
properties.description: True if the range is an outlining summary row or column. The range should be a row or a column. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Returns the formatted text for the specified object. Read-only String.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns a Variant value that represents the distance, in points, from the top edge of row 1 to the top edge of the range.

properties.name: UseStandardHeight
properties.description: True if the row height of the Range object equals the standard height of the sheet. Returns Null if the range contains more than one row and the rows aren't all the same height. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: UseStandardWidth
properties.description: True if the column width of the Range object equals the standard width of the sheet. Returns null if the range contains more than one column and the columns aren't all the same width. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Validation
properties.description: Returns the Validation object that represents data validation for the specified range. Read-only.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the value of the specified range.

properties.name: Value2
properties.description: Returns or sets the cell value. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: VerticalAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the vertical alignment of the specified object. Read/write.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns a Double value that represents the width of a range in points. Read-only.

properties.name: Worksheet
properties.description: Returns a Worksheet object that represents the worksheet containing the specified range. Read-only.

properties.name: WrapText
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that indicates if Microsoft Excel wraps the text in the object.

properties.name: Comment
properties.description: Returns a Comment object that represents the comment associated with the cell in the upper-left corner of the range.

properties.name: Phonetic
properties.description: Returns the Phonetic object, which contains information about a specific phonetic text string in a cell.

properties.name: FormatConditions
properties.description: Returns a FormatConditions collection that represents all the conditional formats for the specified range. Read-only.

properties.name: ReadingOrder
properties.description: Returns or sets the reading order for the specified object. Can be one of the following XlReadingOrder constants: xlRTL (right-to-left), xlLTR (left-to-right), or xlContext. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Hyperlinks
properties.description: Returns a Hyperlinks collection that represents the hyperlinks for the range.

properties.name: Phonetics
properties.description: Returns the Phonetics collection of the range. Read-only.

properties.name: ID
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the identifying label for the specified cell when the page is saved as a webpage.

properties.name: PivotCell
properties.description: Returns a PivotCell object that represents a cell in a PivotTable report.

properties.name: Errors
properties.description: Allows the user to access error checking options.

properties.name: AllowEdit
properties.description: Returns a Boolean value that indicates if the range can be edited on a protected worksheet.

properties.name: ListObject
properties.description: Returns a ListObject object for the Range object. Read-only ListObject object.

properties.name: XPath
properties.description: Returns an XPath object that represents the XPath of the element mapped to the specified Range object. The context of the range determines whether the action succeeds or returns an empty object. Read-only.

properties.name: ServerActions
properties.description: Specifies the actions that can be performed on the SharePoint server for a Range object.

properties.name: MDX
properties.description: Returns the MDX name for the specified Range object. Read-only String.

properties.name: CountLarge
properties.description: Returns a value that represents the number of objects in the collection. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: SparklineGroups
properties.description: Returns a SparklineGroups object that represents an existing group of sparklines from the specified range. Read-only.

properties.name: DisplayFormat
properties.description: Returns a DisplayFormat object that represents the display settings for the specified range. Read-only.

properties.name: HasRichDataType
properties.description: True if all cells in the range contain a Rich data type. False if none of the cells in the range contains a Rich data type; otherwise, null. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: CommentThreaded
properties.description: Returns a CommentThreaded object that represents the threaded comment associated with the cell in the upper-left corner of the range.

properties.name: LinkedDataTypeState
properties.description: Returns information about the state of any Linked data types, such as Stocks or Geography, in the range. Possible values are from the XlLinkedDataTypeState enumeration. Read-only.

properties.name: HasSpill
properties.description: True if all of the cells in the range are part of a spilled range; False if none of the cells in the range are part of a spilled range; null otherwise. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: SpillParent
properties.description: If a cell is a member of a spill, returns the cell containing the formula responsible. Otherwise, an error is returned.

properties.name: Formula2
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the object's formula in A1-style array notation.

properties.name: Formula2Local
properties.description: This is the Formula2 Variant of Range.FormulaLocal. See Range.Formula2 for more detail.

properties.name: Formula2R1C1
properties.description: This is the Formula2 Variant of Range.FormulaR1C1. See Range.Formula2 and Range.FormulaR1C1 for more detail.

properties.name: Formula2R1C1Local
properties.description: This is the Formula2 Variant of Range.FormulaR1C1Local. See Range.Formula2 and Range.FormulaR1C1Local for more detail.

properties.name: SavedAsArray
properties.description: True if all of the cells in the range would be saved to file as an array formula; False if none of the cells in the range would be saved to file as a legacy array formula; null otherwise. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: CellControl
properties.description: This is a child of the Range object, representing the cell controls contained within that range. Properties and methods here let you inspect and modify the cell controls on the range.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates a single cell, which must be inside the current selection. To select a range of cells, use the Select method.

methods.name: AdvancedFilter
methods.signature: AdvancedFilter(Action As XlFilterAction, [CriteriaRange As Variant], [CopyToRange As Variant], [Unique As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Filters or copies data from a list based on a criteria range. If the initial selection is a single cell, that cell's current region is used.

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: One of the constants of XlFilterAction specifying whether to make a copy or filter the list in place.

parameters.name: CriteriaRange
parameters.description: The criteria range. If this argument is omitted, there are no criteria.

parameters.name: CopyToRange
parameters.description: The destination range for the copied rows if _Action_ is xlFilterCopy. Otherwise, this argument is ignored.

parameters.name: Unique
parameters.description: True to filter unique records only. False to filter all records that meet the criteria. The default value is False.

methods.name: ApplyNames
methods.signature: ApplyNames([Names As Variant], [IgnoreRelativeAbsolute As Variant], [UseRowColumnNames As Variant], [OmitColumn As Variant], [OmitRow As Variant], [Order As XlApplyNamesOrder], [AppendLast As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Applies names to the cells in the specified range.

parameters.name: Names
parameters.description: An array of the names to be applied. If this argument is omitted, all names on the sheet are applied to the range.

parameters.name: IgnoreRelativeAbsolute
parameters.description: True to replace references with names, regardless of the reference types of either the names or references. False to replace absolute references only with absolute names, relative references only with relative names, and mixed references only with mixed names. The default value is True.

parameters.name: UseRowColumnNames
parameters.description: True to use the names of row and column ranges that contain the specified range if names for the range cannot be found. False to ignore the _OmitColumn_ and _OmitRow_ arguments. The default value is True.

parameters.name: OmitColumn
parameters.description: True to replace the entire reference with the row-oriented name. The column-oriented name can be omitted only if the referenced cell is in the same column as the formula and is within a row-oriented named range. The default value is True.

parameters.name: OmitRow
parameters.description: True to replace the entire reference with the column-oriented name. The row-oriented name can be omitted only if the referenced cell is in the same row as the formula and is within a column-oriented named range. The default value is True.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: Determines which range name is listed first when a cell reference is replaced by a row-oriented and column-oriented range name.

parameters.name: AppendLast
parameters.description: True to replace the definitions of the names in _Names_ and also replace the definitions of the last names that were defined. False to replace the definitions of the names in _Names_ only. The default value is False.

methods.name: ApplyOutlineStyles
methods.description: Applies outlining styles to the specified range.

methods.name: AutoComplete
methods.description: Returns an AutoComplete match from the list. If there's no AutoComplete match or if more than one entry in the list matches the string to complete, this method returns an empty string.

parameters.name: String
parameters.description: The string to complete.

methods.name: AutoFill
methods.signature: AutoFill(Destination As Range, [Type As XlAutoFillType]) As Variant
methods.description: Performs an autofill on the cells in the specified range.

parameters.name: Destination
parameters.description: The cells to be filled. The destination must include the source range.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Specifies the fill type.

methods.name: AutoFit
methods.description: Changes the width of the columns in the range or the height of the rows in the range to achieve the best fit.

methods.name: AutoOutline
methods.description: Automatically creates an outline for the specified range. If the range is a single cell, Microsoft Excel creates an outline for the entire sheet. The new outline replaces any existing outline.

methods.name: Calculate
methods.description: Calculates all open workbooks, a specific worksheet in a workbook, or a specified range of cells on a worksheet, as shown in the table in the Remarks section.

methods.name: CheckSpelling
methods.signature: CheckSpelling([CustomDictionary As Variant], [IgnoreUppercase As Variant], [AlwaysSuggest As Variant], [SpellLang As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Checks the spelling of an object.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary
parameters.description: A string that indicates the file name of the custom dictionary to be examined if the word isn't found in the main dictionary. If this argument is omitted, the currently specified dictionary is used.

parameters.name: IgnoreUppercase
parameters.description: True to have Microsoft Excel ignore words that are all uppercase. False to have Excel check words that are all uppercase. If this argument is omitted, the current setting will be used.

parameters.name: AlwaysSuggest
parameters.description: True to have Excel display a list of suggested alternate spellings when an incorrect spelling is found. False to have Excel wait for you to input the correct spelling. If this argument is omitted, the current setting will be used.

parameters.name: SpellLang
parameters.description: The language of the dictionary being used. Can be one of the MsoLanguageID values.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the entire object.

methods.name: ClearFormats
methods.description: Clears the formatting of the object.

methods.name: ClearNotes
methods.description: Clears notes and sound notes from all the cells in the specified range.

methods.name: ClearOutline
methods.description: Clears the outline for the specified range.

methods.name: ColumnDifferences
methods.description: Returns a Range object that represents all the cells whose contents are different from the comparison cell in each column.

parameters.name: Comparison
parameters.description: A single cell to compare to the specified range.

methods.name: Consolidate
methods.signature: Consolidate([Sources As Variant], [Function As Variant], [TopRow As Variant], [LeftColumn As Variant], [CreateLinks As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Consolidates data from multiple ranges on multiple worksheets into a single range on a single worksheet. Variant.

parameters.name: Sources
parameters.description: The sources of the consolidation as an array of text reference strings in R1C1-style notation. The references must include the full path of sheets to be consolidated.

parameters.name: Function
parameters.description: One of the constants of XlConsolidationFunction, which specifies the type of consolidation.

parameters.name: TopRow
parameters.description: True to consolidate data based on column titles in the top row of the consolidation ranges. False to consolidate data by position. The default value is False.

parameters.name: LeftColumn
parameters.description: True to consolidate data based on row titles in the left column of the consolidation ranges. False to consolidate data by position. The default value is False.

parameters.name: CreateLinks
parameters.description: True to have the consolidation use worksheet links. False to have the consolidation copy the data. The default value is False.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies the range to the specified range or to the Clipboard.

parameters.name: Destination
parameters.description: Specifies the new range to which the specified range will be copied. If this argument is omitted, Microsoft Excel copies the range to the Clipboard.

methods.name: CopyFromRecordset
methods.signature: CopyFromRecordset(Data As IUnknown, [MaxRows As Variant], [MaxColumns As Variant]) As Long
methods.description: Copies the contents of an ADO or DAO Recordset object onto a worksheet, beginning at the upper-left corner of the specified range. If the Recordset object contains fields with OLE objects in them, this method fails.

parameters.name: Data
parameters.description: The Recordset object to copy into the range.

parameters.name: MaxRows
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to copy onto the worksheet. If this argument is omitted, all the records in the Recordset object are copied.

parameters.name: MaxColumns
parameters.description: The maximum number of fields to copy onto the worksheet. If this argument is omitted, all the fields in the Recordset object are copied.

methods.name: CopyPicture
methods.signature: CopyPicture([Appearance As XlPictureAppearance], [Format As XlCopyPictureFormat]) As Variant
methods.description: Copies the selected object to the Clipboard as a picture. Variant.

parameters.name: Appearance
parameters.description: Specifies how the picture should be copied.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: The format of the picture.

methods.name: CreateNames
methods.signature: CreateNames([Top As Variant], [Left As Variant], [Bottom As Variant], [Right As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Creates names in the specified range, based on text labels in the sheet.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: True to create names by using labels in the top row. The default value is False.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: True to create names by using labels in the left column. The default value is False.

parameters.name: Bottom
parameters.description: True to create names by using labels in the bottom row. The default value is False.

parameters.name: Right
parameters.description: True to create names by using labels in the right column. The default value is False.

methods.name: Cut
methods.description: Cuts the object to the Clipboard or pastes it into a specified destination.

parameters.name: Destination
parameters.description: The range where the object should be pasted. If this argument is omitted, the object is cut to the Clipboard.

methods.name: DataSeries
methods.signature: DataSeries([Rowcol As Variant], [Type As XlDataSeriesType], [Date As XlDataSeriesDate], [Step As Variant], [Stop As Variant], [Trend As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Creates a data series in the specified range. Variant.

parameters.name: Rowcol
parameters.description: Can be the xlRows or xlColumns constant to have the data series entered in rows or columns, respectively. If this argument is omitted, the size and shape of the range is used.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type for the data series.

parameters.name: Date
parameters.description: If the _Type_ argument is xlChronological, the _Date_ argument indicates the step date unit.

parameters.name: Step
parameters.description: The step value for the series. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: Stop
parameters.description: The stop value for the series. If this argument is omitted, Microsoft Excel fills to the end of the range.

parameters.name: Trend
parameters.description: True to create a linear trend or growth trend. False to create a standard data series. The default value is False.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the object.

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description: Used only with Range objects. Specifies how to shift cells to replace deleted cells. Can be one of the following XlDeleteShiftDirection constants: xlShiftToLeft or xlShiftUp. If this argument is omitted, Microsoft Excel decides based on the shape of the range.

methods.name: DialogBox
methods.description: Displays a dialog box defined by a dialog box definition table on a Microsoft Excel 4.0 macro sheet. Returns the number of the chosen control, or returns False if the user chooses the Cancel button.

methods.name: EditionOptions
methods.signature: EditionOptions(Type As XlEditionType, Option As XlEditionOptionsOption, [Name As Variant], [Reference As Variant], [Appearance As XlPictureAppearance], [ChartSize As XlPictureAppearance], [Format As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: You have requested Help for a Visual Basic keyword used only on the Macintosh. For information about this keyword, consult the language reference Help included with Microsoft Office Macintosh Edition.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: See the Help included with Microsoft Office Macintosh Edition.

parameters.name: Option
parameters.description: See the Help included with Microsoft Office Macintosh Edition.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: See the Help included with Microsoft Office Macintosh Edition.

parameters.name: Reference
parameters.description: See the Help included with Microsoft Office Macintosh Edition.

parameters.name: Appearance
parameters.description: See the Help included with Microsoft Office Macintosh Edition.

parameters.name: ChartSize
parameters.description: See the Help included with Microsoft Office Macintosh Edition.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: See the Help included with Microsoft Office Macintosh Edition.

methods.name: FillDown
methods.description: Fills down from the top cell or cells in the specified range to the bottom of the range. The contents and formatting of the cell or cells in the top row of a range are copied into the rest of the rows in the range.

methods.name: FillLeft
methods.description: Fills left from the rightmost cell or cells in the specified range. The contents and formatting of the cell or cells in the rightmost column of a range are copied into the rest of the columns in the range.

methods.name: FillRight
methods.description: Fills right from the leftmost cell or cells in the specified range. The contents and formatting of the cell or cells in the leftmost column of a range are copied into the rest of the columns in the range.

methods.name: FillUp
methods.description: Fills up from the bottom cell or cells in the specified range to the top of the range. The contents and formatting of the cell or cells in the bottom row of a range are copied into the rest of the rows in the range.

methods.name: Find
methods.signature: Find(What As Variant, [After As Variant], [LookIn As Variant], [LookAt As Variant], [SearchOrder As Variant], [SearchDirection As XlSearchDirection], [MatchCase As Variant], [MatchByte As Variant], [SearchFormat As Variant]) As Range
methods.description: Finds specific information in a range.

parameters.name: What
parameters.description: The data to search for. Can be a string or any Microsoft Excel data type.

parameters.name: After
parameters.description: The cell after which you want the search to begin. This corresponds to the position of the active cell when a search is done from the user interface. Notice that _After_ must be a single cell in the range. Remember that the search begins after this cell; the specified cell isn't searched until the method wraps back around to this cell. If you don't specify this argument, the search starts after the cell in the upper-left corner of the range.

parameters.name: LookIn
parameters.description: Can be one of the following XlFindLookIn constants: xlFormulas, xlValues, xlComments, or xlCommentsThreaded.

parameters.name: LookAt
parameters.description: Can be one of the following XlLookAt constants: xlWhole or xlPart.

parameters.name: SearchOrder
parameters.description: Can be one of the following XlSearchOrder constants: xlByRows or xlByColumns.

parameters.name: SearchDirection
parameters.description: Can be one of the following XlSearchDirection constants: xlNext or xlPrevious.

parameters.name: MatchCase
parameters.description: True to make the search case-sensitive. The default value is False.

parameters.name: MatchByte
parameters.description: Used only if you have selected or installed double-byte language support. True to have double-byte characters match only double-byte characters. False to have double-byte characters match their single-byte equivalents.

parameters.name: SearchFormat
parameters.description: The search format.

methods.name: FindNext
methods.description: Continues a search that was begun with the Find method. Finds the next cell that matches those same conditions and returns a Range object that represents that cell. This does not affect the selection or the active cell.

parameters.name: After
parameters.description: The cell after which you want to search. This corresponds to the position of the active cell when a search is done from the user interface. Be aware that _After_ must be a single cell in the range.

methods.name: FindPrevious
methods.description: Continues a search that was begun with the Find method. Finds the previous cell that matches those same conditions and returns a Range object that represents that cell. Doesn't affect the selection or the active cell.

methods.name: FunctionWizard
methods.description: Starts the Function Wizard for the upper-left cell of the range.

methods.name: Group
methods.signature: Group([Start As Variant], [End As Variant], [By As Variant], [Periods As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: When the Range object represents a single cell in a PivotTable field's data range, the Group method performs numeric or date-based grouping in that field.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: The first value to be grouped. If this argument is omitted or True, the first value in the field is used.

parameters.name: End
parameters.description: The last value to be grouped. If this argument is omitted or True, the last value in the field is used.

parameters.name: By
parameters.description: If the field is numeric, this argument specifies the size of each group. If the field is a date, this argument specifies the number of days in each group if element 4 in the _Periods_ array is True and all the other elements are False. Otherwise, this argument is ignored. If this argument is omitted, Microsoft Excel automatically chooses a default group size.

parameters.name: Periods
parameters.description: An array of Boolean values that specify the period for the group, described in the Remarks section. If an element in the array is True, a group is created for the corresponding time; if the element is False, no group is created. If the field isn't a date field, this argument is ignored.

methods.name: InsertIndent
methods.description: Adds an indent to the specified range.

parameters.name: InsertAmount
parameters.description: The amount to be added to the current indent.

methods.name: Insert
methods.signature: Insert([Shift As Variant], [CopyOrigin As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Inserts a cell or a range of cells into the worksheet or macro sheet and shifts other cells away to make space.

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description: Specifies which way to shift the cells. Can be one of the following XlInsertShiftDirection constants: xlShiftToRight or xlShiftDown. If this argument is omitted, Microsoft Excel decides based on the shape of the range.

parameters.name: CopyOrigin
parameters.description: The copy origin; that is, from where to copy the format for inserted cells. Can be one of the following XlInsertFormatOrigin constants: xlFormatFromLeftOrAbove (default) or xlFormatFromRightOrBelow.

methods.name: Justify
methods.description: Rearranges the text in a range so that it fills the range evenly.

methods.name: ListNames
methods.description: Pastes a list of all nonhidden names onto the worksheet, beginning with the first cell in the range.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Creates a merged cell from the specified Range object.

parameters.name: Across
parameters.description: True to merge cells in each row of the specified range as separate merged cells. The default value is False.

methods.name: UnMerge
methods.description: Separates a merged area into individual cells.

methods.name: NavigateArrow
methods.signature: NavigateArrow([TowardPrecedent As Variant], [ArrowNumber As Variant], [LinkNumber As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Navigates a tracer arrow for the specified range to the precedent, dependent, or error-causing cell or cells. Selects the precedent, dependent, or error cells and returns a Range object that represents the new selection. This method causes an error if it's applied to a cell without visible tracer arrows.

parameters.name: TowardPrecedent
parameters.description: Specifies the direction to navigate; True to navigate toward precedents, False to navigate toward dependents.

parameters.name: ArrowNumber
parameters.description: Specifies the arrow number to navigate; corresponds to the numbered reference in the cell's formula.

parameters.name: LinkNumber
parameters.description: If the arrow is an external reference arrow, this argument indicates which external reference to follow. If this argument is omitted, the first external reference is followed.

methods.name: NoteText
methods.signature: NoteText([Text As Variant], [Start As Variant], [Length As Variant]) As String
methods.description: Returns or sets the cell note associated with the cell in the upper-left corner of the range. Read/write String. Cell notes have been replaced by range comments. For more information, see the Comment object.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The text to add to the note (up to 255 characters). The text is inserted starting at position _Start_, replacing _Length_ characters of the existing note. If this argument is omitted, this method returns the current text of the note starting at position _Start_, for _Length_ characters.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: The starting position for the text that's set or returned. If this argument is omitted, this method starts at the first character. To append text to the note, specify a number larger than the number of characters in the existing note.

parameters.name: Length
parameters.description: The number of characters to be set or returned. If this argument is omitted, Microsoft Excel sets or returns characters from the starting position to the end of the note (up to 255 characters). If there are more than 255 characters from _Start_ to the end of the note, this method returns only 255 characters.

methods.name: Parse
methods.signature: Parse([ParseLine As Variant], [Destination As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Parses a range of data and breaks it into multiple cells. Distributes the contents of the range to fill several adjacent columns; the range can be no more than one column wide.

parameters.name: ParseLine
parameters.description: A string that contains left and right brackets to indicate where the cells should be split.

parameters.name: Destination
parameters.description: A Range object that represents the upper-left corner of the destination range for the parsed data. If this argument is omitted, Microsoft Excel parses in place.

methods.name: PrintPreview
methods.description: Shows a preview of the object as it would look when printed.

parameters.name: EnableChanges
parameters.description: Pass a Boolean value to specify if the user can change the margins and other page setup options available in print preview.

methods.name: RemoveSubtotal
methods.description: Removes subtotals from a list.

methods.name: RowDifferences
methods.description: Returns a Range object that represents all the cells whose contents are different from those of the comparison cell in each row.

parameters.name: Comparison
parameters.description: A single cell to compare with the specified range.

methods.name: Run
methods.signature: Run([Arg1 As Variant], [Arg2 As Variant], [Arg3 As Variant], [Arg4 As Variant], [Arg5 As Variant], [Arg6 As Variant], [Arg7 As Variant], [Arg8 As Variant], [Arg9 As Variant], [Arg10 As Variant], [Arg11 As Variant], [Arg12 As Variant], [Arg13 As Variant], [Arg14 As Variant], [Arg15 As Variant], [Arg16 As Variant], [Arg17 As Variant], [Arg18 As Variant], [Arg19 As Variant], [Arg20 As Variant], [Arg21 As Variant], [Arg22 As Variant], [Arg23 As Variant], [Arg24 As Variant], [Arg25 As Variant], [Arg26 As Variant], [Arg27 As Variant], [Arg28 As Variant], [Arg29 As Variant], [Arg30 As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Runs the Microsoft Excel macro at this location. The range must be on a macro sheet.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Selects the object.

methods.name: Show
methods.description: Scrolls through the contents of the active window to move the range into view. The range must consist of a single cell in the active document.

methods.name: ShowDependents
methods.description: Draws tracer arrows to the direct dependents of the range.

parameters.name: Remove
parameters.description: True to remove one level of tracer arrows to direct dependents. False to expand one level of tracer arrows. The default value is False.

methods.name: ShowErrors
methods.description: Draws tracer arrows through the precedents tree to the cell that's the source of the error, and returns the range that contains that cell.

methods.name: ShowPrecedents
methods.description: Draws tracer arrows to the direct precedents of the range.

parameters.name: Remove
parameters.description: True to remove one level of tracer arrows to direct precedents. False to expand one level of tracer arrows. The default value is False.

methods.name: SortSpecial
methods.signature: SortSpecial([SortMethod As XlSortMethod], [Key1 As Variant], [Order1 As XlSortOrder], [Type As Variant], [Key2 As Variant], [Order2 As XlSortOrder], [Key3 As Variant], [Order3 As XlSortOrder], [Header As XlYesNoGuess], [OrderCustom As Variant], [MatchCase As Variant], [Orientation As XlSortOrientation], [DataOption1 As XlSortDataOption], [DataOption2 As XlSortDataOption], [DataOption3 As XlSortDataOption]) As Variant
methods.description: Uses East Asian sorting methods to sort the range, a PivotTable report, or uses the method for the active region if the range contains only one cell. For example, Japanese sorts in the order of the Kana syllabary.

parameters.name: SortMethod
parameters.description: The type of sort. Some of these constants may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: Key1
parameters.description: The first sort field, as either text (a PivotTable field or range name) or a Range object ("Dept" or Cells(1, 1), for example).

parameters.name: Order1
parameters.description: The sort order for the field or range specified in the _Key1_ argument.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Specifies which elements are to be sorted. Use this argument only when sorting PivotTable reports.

parameters.name: Key2
parameters.description: The second sort field, as either text (a PivotTable field or range name) or a Range object. If you omit this argument, there's no second sort field. Cannot be used when sorting PivotTable reports.

parameters.name: Order2
parameters.description: The sort order for the field or range specified in the _Key2_ argument. Cannot be used when sorting PivotTable reports.

parameters.name: Key3
parameters.description: The third sort field, as either text (a range name) or a Range object. If you omit this argument, there's no third sort field. Cannot be used when sorting PivotTable reports.

parameters.name: Order3
parameters.description: The sort order for the field or range specified in the _Key3_ argument. Cannot be used when sorting PivotTable reports.

parameters.name: Header
parameters.description: Specifies whether or not the first row contains headers. Cannot be used when sorting PivotTable reports.

parameters.name: OrderCustom
parameters.description: This argument is a one-based integer offset to the list of custom sort orders. If you omit _OrderCustom_, (normal sort order) is used.

parameters.name: MatchCase
parameters.description: True to do a case-sensitive sort; False to do a sort that's not case-sensitive. Cannot be used when sorting PivotTable reports.

parameters.name: Orientation
parameters.description: The sort orientation.

parameters.name: DataOption1
parameters.description: Specifies how to sort text in _Key1_. Cannot be used when sorting PivotTable reports.

parameters.name: DataOption2
parameters.description: Specifies how to sort text in _Key2_. Cannot be used when sorting PivotTable reports.

parameters.name: DataOption3
parameters.description: Specifies how to sort text in _Key3_. Cannot be used when sorting PivotTable reports.

methods.name: SpecialCells
methods.signature: SpecialCells(Type As XlCellType, [Value As Variant]) As Range
methods.description: Returns a Range object that represents all the cells that match the specified type and value.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The cells to include.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: If _Type_ is either xlCellTypeConstants or xlCellTypeFormulas, this argument is used to determine which types of cells to include in the result. These values can be added together to return more than one type. The default is to select all constants or formulas, no matter what the type.

methods.name: SubscribeTo
methods.signature: SubscribeTo(Edition As String, [Format As XlSubscribeToFormat]) As Variant
methods.description: You have requested Help for a Visual Basic keyword used only on the Macintosh. For information about this keyword, consult the language reference Help included with Microsoft Office Macintosh Edition.

parameters.name: Edition
parameters.description: See help included with Microsoft Office Macintosh Edition.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: See help included with Microsoft Office Macintosh Edition.

methods.name: Subtotal
methods.signature: Subtotal(GroupBy As Long, Function As XlConsolidationFunction, TotalList As Variant, [Replace As Variant], [PageBreaks As Variant], [SummaryBelowData As XlSummaryRow]) As Variant
methods.description: Creates subtotals for the range (or the current region, if the range is a single cell).

parameters.name: GroupBy
parameters.description: The field to group by, as a one-based integer offset. For more information, see the example.

parameters.name: Function
parameters.description: The subtotal function.

parameters.name: TotalList
parameters.description: An array of 1-based field offsets, indicating the fields to which the subtotals are added. For more information, see the example.

parameters.name: Replace
parameters.description: True to replace existing subtotals. The default value is True.

parameters.name: PageBreaks
parameters.description: True to add page breaks after each group. The default value is False.

parameters.name: SummaryBelowData
parameters.description: Places the summary data relative to the subtotal.

methods.name: Table
methods.signature: Table([RowInput As Variant], [ColumnInput As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Creates a data table based on input values and formulas that you define on a worksheet.

parameters.name: RowInput
parameters.description: A single cell to use as the row input for your table.

parameters.name: ColumnInput
parameters.description: A single cell to use as the column input for your table.

methods.name: TextToColumns
methods.signature: TextToColumns([Destination As Variant], [DataType As XlTextParsingType], [TextQualifier As XlTextQualifier], [ConsecutiveDelimiter As Variant], [Tab As Variant], [Semicolon As Variant], [Comma As Variant], [Space As Variant], [Other As Variant], [OtherChar As Variant], [FieldInfo As Variant], [DecimalSeparator As Variant], [ThousandsSeparator As Variant], [TrailingMinusNumbers As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Parses a column of cells that contain text into several columns.

parameters.name: Destination
parameters.description: A Range object that specifies where Microsoft Excel will place the results. If the range is larger than a single cell, the top left cell is used.

parameters.name: DataType
parameters.description: The format of the text to be split into columns.

parameters.name: TextQualifier
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use single, double, or no quotes as the text qualifier.

parameters.name: ConsecutiveDelimiter
parameters.description: True to have Excel consider consecutive delimiters as one delimiter. The default value is False.

parameters.name: Tab
parameters.description: True to have _DataType_ be xlDelimited and to have the tab character be a delimiter. The default value is False.

parameters.name: Semicolon
parameters.description: True to have _DataType_ be xlDelimited and to have the semicolon be a delimiter. The default value is False.

parameters.name: Comma
parameters.description: True to have _DataType_ be xlDelimited and to have the comma be a delimiter. The default value is False.

parameters.name: Space
parameters.description: True to have _DataType_ be xlDelimited and to have the space character be a delimiter. The default value is False.

parameters.name: Other
parameters.description: True to have _DataType_ be xlDelimited and to have the character specified by the _OtherChar_ argument be a delimiter. The default value is False.

parameters.name: OtherChar
parameters.description: Required if _Other_ is True; the delimiter character when _Other_ is True. If more than one character is specified, only the first character of the string is used; the remaining characters are ignored.

parameters.name: FieldInfo
parameters.description: An array containing parse information for the individual columns of data. The interpretation depends on the value of _DataType_. When the data is delimited, this argument is an array of two-element arrays, with each two-element array specifying the conversion options for a particular column. The first element is the column number (1-based), and the second element is one of the XlColumnDataType constants specifying how the column is parsed.

parameters.name: DecimalSeparator
parameters.description: The decimal separator that Microsoft Excel uses when recognizing numbers. The default setting is the system setting.

parameters.name: ThousandsSeparator
parameters.description: The thousands separator that Excel uses when recognizing numbers. The default setting is the system setting.

parameters.name: TrailingMinusNumbers
parameters.description: Numbers that begin with a minus character.

methods.name: Ungroup
methods.description: Promotes a range in an outline (that is, decreases its outline level). The specified range must be a row or column, or a range of rows or columns. If the range is in a PivotTable report, this method ungroups the items contained in the range.

methods.name: AddComment
methods.description: Adds a comment to the range.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The comment text.

methods.name: ClearComments
methods.description: Clears all cell comments from the specified range.

methods.name: SetPhonetic
methods.description: Creates Phonetic objects for all the cells in the specified range.

methods.name: Dirty
methods.description: Designates a range to be recalculated when the next recalculation occurs.

methods.name: Speak
methods.description: Causes the cells of the range to be spoken in row order or column order.

parameters.name: SpeakDirection
parameters.description: The speak direction, by rows or columns.

parameters.name: SpeakFormulas
parameters.description: True will cause formulas to be sent to the Text-To-Speech (TTS) engine for cells that have formulas. The value is sent if the cells don't have formulas. False (default) will cause values to always be sent to the TTS engine.

methods.name: PasteSpecial
methods.signature: PasteSpecial([Paste As XlPasteType], [Operation As XlPasteSpecialOperation], [SkipBlanks As Variant], [Transpose As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Pastes a Range object that has been copied into the specified range.

parameters.name: Paste
parameters.description: The part of the range to be pasted, such as xlPasteAll or xlPasteValues.

parameters.name: Operation
parameters.description: The paste operation, such as xlPasteSpecialOperationAdd.

parameters.name: SkipBlanks
parameters.description: True to have blank cells in the range on the clipboard not be pasted into the destination range. The default value is False.

parameters.name: Transpose
parameters.description: True to transpose rows and columns when the range is pasted. The default value is False.

methods.name: RemoveDuplicates
methods.description: Removes duplicate values from a range of values.

parameters.name: Columns
parameters.description: Array of indexes of the columns that contain the duplicate information.

parameters.name: Header
parameters.description: Specifies whether the first row contains header information. xlNo is the default value; specify xlGuess if you want Excel to attempt to determine the header.

methods.name: PrintOut
methods.signature: PrintOut([From As Variant], [To As Variant], [Copies As Variant], [Preview As Variant], [ActivePrinter As Variant], [PrintToFile As Variant], [Collate As Variant], [PrToFileName As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Prints the object.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The number of the page at which to start printing. If this argument is omitted, printing starts at the beginning.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: The number of the last page to print. If this argument is omitted, printing ends with the last page.

parameters.name: Copies
parameters.description: The number of copies to print. If this argument is omitted, one copy is printed.

parameters.name: Preview
parameters.description: True to have Microsoft Excel invoke print preview before printing the object. False (or omitted) to print the object immediately.

parameters.name: ActivePrinter
parameters.description: Sets the name of the active printer.

parameters.name: PrintToFile
parameters.description: True to print to a file. If _PrToFileName_ is not specified, Microsoft Excel prompts the user to enter the name of the output file.

parameters.name: Collate
parameters.description: True to collate multiple copies.

parameters.name: PrToFileName
parameters.description: If _PrintToFile_ is set to True, this argument specifies the name of the file that you want to print to.

methods.name: CalculateRowMajorOrder
methods.description: Calculates a specified range of cells.

methods.name: ClearHyperlinks
methods.description: Removes all hyperlinks from the specified range.

methods.name: BorderAround
methods.signature: BorderAround([LineStyle As Variant], [Weight As XlBorderWeight], [ColorIndex As XlColorIndex], [Color As Variant], [ThemeColor As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Adds a border to a range and sets the Color, LineStyle, and Weight properties of the Border object for the new border. Variant.

parameters.name: LineStyle
parameters.description: One of the constants of XlLineStyle specifying the line style for the border.

parameters.name: Weight
parameters.description: The border weight.

parameters.name: ColorIndex
parameters.description: The border color, as an index into the current color palette or as an XlColorIndex constant.

parameters.name: Color
parameters.description: The border color, as an RGB value.

parameters.name: ThemeColor
parameters.description: The theme color, as an index into the current color theme or as an XlThemeColor value.

methods.name: AllocateChanges
methods.description: Performs a writeback operation for all edited cells in a range based on an OLAP data source.

methods.name: DiscardChanges
methods.description: Discards all changes in the edited cells of the range.

methods.name: FlashFill
methods.description: True indicates that the Excel Flash Fill feature has been enabled and is active.

methods.name: ExportAsFixedFormat
methods.signature: ExportAsFixedFormat(Type As XlFixedFormatType, [Filename As Variant], [Quality As Variant], [IncludeDocProperties As Variant], [IgnorePrintAreas As Variant], [From As Variant], [To As Variant], [OpenAfterPublish As Variant], [FixedFormatExtClassPtr As Variant], [WorkIdentity As Variant])
methods.description: Exports to a file of the specified format.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of file format to export to.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: The file name of the file to be saved. You can include a full path, or Excel saves the file in the current folder.

parameters.name: Quality
parameters.description: Optional XlFixedFormatQuality. Specifies the quality of the published file.

parameters.name: IncludeDocProperties

parameters.name: IgnorePrintAreas

parameters.name: To

parameters.name: OpenAfterPublish

parameters.name: FixedFormatExtClassPtr
parameters.description: Pointer to the FixedFormatExt class.

methods.name: ShowCard
methods.description: For a cell containing a Linked data type, such as Stocks or Geography, this method causes a card to appear that shows details about the cell (that is, the same card that the user can view by choosing the cell icon).

methods.name: AddCommentThreaded
methods.description: Adds a new modern threaded comment to the range if no comment already exists.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The comment text.

methods.name: Sort
methods.signature: Sort([Key1 As Variant], [Order1 As XlSortOrder], [Key2 As Variant], [Type As Variant], [Order2 As XlSortOrder], [Key3 As Variant], [Order3 As XlSortOrder], [Header As XlYesNoGuess], [OrderCustom As Variant], [MatchCase As Variant], [Orientation As XlSortOrientation], [SortMethod As XlSortMethod], [DataOption1 As XlSortDataOption], [DataOption2 As XlSortDataOption], [DataOption3 As XlSortDataOption], [SubField1 As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Sorts a range of values.

parameters.name: Key1

parameters.name: Order1

parameters.name: Key2

parameters.name: Order2

parameters.name: Key3
parameters.description: Third sort field; cannot be used when sorting a PivotTable.

parameters.name: Order3
parameters.description: Determines the sort order for the values specified in _Key3_.

parameters.name: Header
parameters.description: Specifies whether the first row contains header information. xlNo is the default value; specify xlGuess if you want Excel to attempt to determine the header.

parameters.name: OrderCustom

parameters.name: MatchCase

parameters.name: DataOption2
parameters.description: Specifies how to sort text in the range specified in _Key2_; does not apply to PivotTable sorting.

parameters.name: DataOption3
parameters.description: Specifies how to sort text in the range specified in _Key3_; does not apply to PivotTable sorting.

methods.name: AutoFilter
methods.signature: AutoFilter([Field As Variant], [Criteria1 As Variant], [Operator As XlAutoFilterOperator], [Criteria2 As Variant], [VisibleDropDown As Variant], [SubField As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Filters a list by using the AutoFilter.

parameters.name: Criteria1

parameters.name: LanguageCulture
parameters.description: A string representing the LCID of the language and culture that you would like to use for the linked entity.

methods.name: DataTypeToText

parameters.name: SearchOrder
parameters.description: Can be one of the following XlSearchOrder constants: xlByRows or xlByColumns.

parameters.name: MatchCase
